title: Everyday or Sometimes Foods?
retry: Listen once more and choose a pile.

items.note: Fruit gives your body fibre and nutrients.
Carrots help make a varied meal.
Oats give your body energy and fibre.
Beans give your body protein and fibre.
Water helps your body stay hydrated.
This meal brings several kinds of food together.
Yogurt and berries add protein and fruit to your snack.
Candy is a food we can enjoy sometimes alongside our usual meals.
Cake is one way to enjoy a celebration.
We usually drink water and have soda sometimes.
Candy can fit sometimes without taking the place of a meal.
A doughnut can be a sometimes breakfast treat.

items.text: A frozen banana with no added sugar.
items.note: Freezing a banana does not stop it being fruit.
A fruit flavour does not make candy a piece of fruit.
Raisins are grapes with much of their water dried out.

items.text: An ice cream cone after dinner.
items.note: You can enjoy ice cream sometimes and still eat varied meals.

items.text: A sweet cereal bar covered in frosting.
items.note: The frosting makes this more like a sometimes sweet than plain oats.
